::: {#rem-wlog}
#### Without loss of generality

@sol-max-min is a proof by cases (@def-proof-by-cases)
with two cases, $x \le y$ and $y \le x$.
The proof of the second case is the proof of the first
with the names $x$ and $y$ swapped,
which changes neither side of the equation.
"Without loss of generality, suppose $x \le y$"
says this, and writes out only the first case.
Use it only when the other cases really are the same proof with names changed.

:::
